title: Cup Holder Size and Cover
summary: Feedback on cup holders centers on complaints about small holder size and a retractable cover design, while several other mentions are too fragmentary or context-free to show clear sentiment.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention cup holders being too small and criticize the retractable cover that conceals the holders when not in use.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention lack of cup-holder cooling or heating, requests for extra cup holders, and incidental references to items sitting in or obstructed by the cup holder without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: Several fragments are brief or incidental mentions of cup holders without enough context to determine clear sentiment.
One example references another brand's cup holders, so the comparison context limits how specifically it reflects the G70 cup holder experience.
The sample is small and stratified, so it may mix requests, comparisons, and incidental mentions rather than a single consistent issue.
